dynamic_ci_initial.scope: dynamic evaluation + realization; fresh planner, warm tools and Go package outputs; cache metadata queries follow the selected Nix settings

source_edits.scope: Dynamic evaluation and realization after each main.go edit; warm tools and dependency outputs; fresh planning and unique application output per revision/trial; no remote lookups.

module_transfer.scope: Sum of NAR and zstd level 3 file sizes for complete closures; local binary cache, no network timing

module_preparation.scope: Fresh sandboxed module-cache preparation; fixed proxy, CLI, and SDK already available; ignored recipe nonce forces each preparation; includes Nix hashing and output registration; excludes remote transfer and initial tool/proxy builds.

module_restoration.scope: Local zstd level 3 NAR decompression plus restore into fresh directories; warm compressed input; no network, database registration, or fsync guarantee. Includes file creation and writes; excludes deletion.

evaluation_initial.scope: Warm graph evaluation; no builds; iets tracing cache and Nix fallback disabled

evaluation_followup.scope: Warm graph evaluation; no builds; iets tracing cache and Nix fallback disabled

cli_closure.scope: Sum of NAR and zstd level 3 file sizes for complete closures; local binary cache, no network timing

probe_scripts.preparation:
import json, pathlib, statistics, subprocess, time, uuid
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/drvgo-cache-preparation-benchmark')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
base='((import /tmp/drvgo-ci-module-cache/nix/dynamic.nix {}) { src=/nix/store/r3azknj8cz74gnw86kdq2jcjvg4vc1wd-source; package="./cmd/upm"; prepareModules=true; vendorHash="sha256-A4CU4C5SmEZP6Q+CVHjp+Jy4UxRXAnpvhzrsdq4NlsM="; }).moduleCache'
flags=['--extra-experimental-features','ca-derivations dynamic-derivations recursive-nix','--option','allow-import-from-derivation','false','--option','sandbox','true','--option','sandbox-fallback','false','--option','substituters','','--option','always-allow-substitutes','false','--max-jobs','2','--cores','2']
rows=[]
for trial in range(6):
 nonce=uuid.uuid4().hex
 expr='let d='+base+'; in builtins.derivation (d.drvAttrs // { DRVGO_BENCHMARK_NONCE="'+nonce+'"; })'
 with (out/(str(trial)+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  start=time.monotonic()
  drv=subprocess.check_output(['nix-instantiate',*flags,'--expr',expr],stderr=log,text=True).strip()
  evaluated=time.monotonic()
  result=subprocess.check_output(['nix-store',*flags,'--realise',drv],stderr=log,text=True).strip()
  end=time.monotonic()
 assert result=='/nix/store/vcal7z7fvgv4gi7vxnhj3002vc4klsaq-drvgo-module-cache'
 assert 'building ' in (out/(str(trial)+'.log')).read_text()
 row=dict(trial=trial,warmup=trial==0,evaluation=evaluated-start,realization=end-evaluated,total=end-start,derivation=drv,result=result)
 rows.append(row)
 print(row,flush=True)
report={'scope':'Fresh sandboxed module-cache preparation; fixed proxy, CLI, and SDK already available; ignored recipe nonce forces each preparation; includes Nix hashing and output registration; excludes remote transfer and initial tool/proxy builds.', 'records':rows,'medians':{phase:statistics.median(r[phase] for r in rows if not r['warmup']) for phase in ['evaluation','realization','total']}}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(report['medians'])
probe_scripts.restoration:
import json, pathlib, shutil, statistics, subprocess, tempfile, time
cache=pathlib.Path('/tmp/drvgo-module-cache-transfer-probe/cache')
roots={'proxy':'h98rgzjab1dcnpwkz4akbggjk98zr13a','prepared':'8dlb7aj0ya44d1aj7d85j1i7rrq3h9b5'}
archives={}
for label, root in roots.items():
    info=dict(line.split(': ',1) for line in (cache/(root+'.narinfo')).read_text().splitlines() if ': ' in line)
    archives[label]=cache/info['URL']
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/drvgo-cache-restore-benchmark')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
records=[]
for trial in range(6):
    for label in (list(roots) if trial%2==0 else list(reversed(roots))):
        dest=out/(label+'-'+str(trial))
        start=time.monotonic()
        with archives[label].open('rb') as src:
            z=subprocess.Popen(['zstd','-d','-q','-c'],stdin=src,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
            r=subprocess.run(['nix-store','--restore',str(dest)],stdin=z.stdout,check=True)
            z.stdout.close()
            assert z.wait()==0
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
        records.append(dict(label=label,trial=trial,warmup=trial==0,seconds=elapsed))
        print(label,trial,elapsed,flush=True)
        shutil.rmtree(dest)
report={'scope':'Local zstd level 3 NAR decompression plus restore into fresh directories; warm compressed input; no network, database registration, or fsync guarantee. Includes file creation and writes; excludes deletion.', 'records':records}
report['medians']={label:statistics.median(r['seconds'] for r in records if r['label']==label and not r['warmup']) for label in roots}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(report['medians'])
